thread_title: S. leucophylla var. alba  Mobile Co, AL (MK L042)
breadcrumb: S. leucophylla var. alba  Mobile Co, AL (MK L042)

posts.body_html:
I just love this clone originally from Mike King's collection. However, I have to admit it's slower than a snail in terms of how fast it grows. The white can really cover a large portion of the pitcher, moreso than many of your typical S. leucophylla clones. This clone produces yellow flowers, and as you can see from the shape, it likely has S. alata in its genetics:

posts.body_html: That is one beautiful plant. A pinch of alata genetics in introgressed leucophyllas is not a bad thing at all.  I have ipL36 from Aidan Selwyn, which I think is the same clone. Mine arrived fairly tall (above 2 feet) last year, but it was a small division and didn't put a lot of pitchers. I am anxiously waiting to see what it does this year!
